statements.t: “The strong momentum gives us the confidence to further raise our full-year 2026 outlook across all financial metrics, while our positive patient outcomes, most recently across TMS and Spravato, reflect our commitment to clinical excellence.
For the fourth quarter of 2026, the Company expects total revenue of $446 million to $466 million, Center Margin of $149 million to $163 million, and Adjusted EBITDA of $56 million to $64 million.

These statements include, but are not limited to, statements with respect to: full year and fourth quarter guidance and management's related assumptions; business plans and objectives; our share repurchase authorization and repurchases thereunder; and other statements contained in this press release that are not historical facts.

Management acknowledges that there are many items that impact a company’s reported results and the adjustments reflected in these non-GAAP measures are not intended to present all items that may have impacted these results.

Litigation costs, net of insurance recoveries, include only those costs which are considered non-recurring and outside of the ordinary course of business based on the following considerations, which we assess regularly: (i) the frequency of similar cases that have been brought to date, or are expected to be brought within two years, (ii) the complexity of the case (e.g., complex class action litigation), (iii)…
